verdict.rationale: Corporations Canada is a government registry service, not an agent, so an official MCP server is a fair question. The evidence documents only web filing (the Online Filing Centre) and PDF channels, with no MCP server. The probe found a keyless CKAN API on open.canada.ca, but that belongs to the separate national open-data portal, is not MCP, and the probe notes the registry itself documents no transactional API, so it earns no credit.
